definition: Universal Networking Language (UNL) is a declarative formal language specifically designed to represent semantic data extracted from natural language texts.
details: It can be used as a pivot language in interlingual machine translation systems or as a knowledge representation language in information retrieval applications.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. In plain words: Universal Networking Language (UNL) is a declarative formal language specifically designed to represent semantic data extracted from natural language texts. Here is how it actually plays out: It can be used as a pivot language in interlingual machine translation systems or as a knowledge representation language in information retrieval applications. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is Universal Networking Language.
